message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_extrathoracic_findings_via_pixel_inspection", "description": "When a generated chest X-ray report omits visually evident extrathoracic findings (e.g., surgical emphysema, subcutaneous air), prioritize direct visual verification of the image pixel data over the text report.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical imaging interpretation where automated or preliminary text reports may lack comprehensive coverage of non-pulmonary or extrathoracic abnormalities visible in the image.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the `chest_xray_report_generator` output fails to mention extrathoracic findings that are visually apparent in the image (such as surgical emphysema or soft tissue abnormalities): (1) Do not accept the generated report as complete; (2) Perform a direct visual inspection of the raw pixel data focusing on extrathoracic regions (neck, shoulders, chest wall); (3) Manually annotate or override the report to include these verified findings before finalizing the diagnosis."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
